csv_project_name: Planning/Design for Jefferson Ave Corridor Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Virginia department of transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide a Planning/Design for Jefferson Ave Corridor Improvements. Funding will support several improvements along Jefferson Avenue at Hogan Drive and Thimble Shoals Boulevard. For Jefferson Avenue and Hogan Drive: adding a new dedicated left turn lane on the eastbound side of Hogan Drive, adding a new right turn lane on the southbound side; reconstructing the radii on all corners to accommodate school buses, new Americans with Disabilities (ADA) compliant curb ramps, crosswalks; pedestrian refuge islands on Jefferson Avenue, reconstructing the sidewalk along Jefferson Avenue and the sidewalk along Hogan Drive; and relocating the existing pedestrian signals to meet current standards. For Jefferson Avenue and Thimble Shoals Boulevard: constructing a new sidewalk on Thimble Shoals from the corner to the first entrance; replacing the westbound channelized right turn lane with a tighter radii; adding an second westbound right turn lane; closing the median on Thimble Shoals eastbound to extend the left turn lane about 245 feet; providing curb ramps, crosswalks, and pedestrian signals to meet current standards; and providing new pedestrian refuge islands on the north, south, and west legs of the intersection.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
